alerts.description: SQL injection - user email concatenated directly into query.
alerts.remediation: Use parameterized query: db.query('... WHERE email = ?', [email])

alerts.description: Reflected XSS - search term echoed into HTML without escaping.
alerts.remediation: HTML-escape output or render via an autoescaping template engine.

alerts.description: Verbose error handler returns stack traces to clients.
alerts.remediation: Log stack server-side; return a generic message to the client.
